full_judgment: 4. The trial court framed 4(four) issues for determination of the dispute. In course of hearing, the plaintiff examined 4(four) witnesses as PWs and the defendant examined 3(three) witnesses as DWs. The plaintiff filed agreement for sale in question and relevant khatian in the name of Rowshanara Begum which was duly marked as exhibits. The trial court upon hearing decreed the suit by its judgment and decree dated 29-10-2008.
